source_document_title: Inter-examiner reliability in periodontal diagnosis and treatment planning using the 2018 classification and the EFP S3 clinical guideline
source_sentence: Treatment planning followed the structured stepwise approach of the guideline: Step 1 (supragingival biofilm control by the patient and professionally delivered, and risk factor control including smoking cessation and glycemic management); Step 2 (subgingival instrumentation, with or without adjunctive chemical agents or systemically administered antibiotics); Step 3 (resective or regenerative periodontal surgery); and Step 4 (supportive periodontal care).
summary_sentence: Treatment planning agreement was perfect for supragingival biofilm control and diabetes management (κ = 1.000) and almost perfect for smoking cessation counseling (κ = 0.973).
